{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count total rows
total_rows = len(data)
print(f"Total rows in dataset: {total_rows}")

# Find duplicate patient_id entries
duplicate_mask = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_rows = data[duplicate_mask]
duplicate_count = len(duplicate_rows)
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicate_count}")

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients
num_patients = len(deduplicated_data)
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {num_patients}")"}
